first.rationale: I currently favor simplifying onboarding because completion and activation are both declining, and memory_86 indicates this can improve time-to-value and early adoption. I would verify memory_86 because its durable-revenue impact is not stated, and memory_73 because promotional pricing directly addresses the competitive threat but may carry unreported retention, discounting, or customer-quality risk. A guarded test is appropriate until those downstream effects are clear.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified source directly matches the current 4% completion decline and showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Promotional pricing is rejected despite the competitor threat because its +18% qualified-revenue lift came with 30-day retention down 12% and failure before first renewal. Longer-term retention beyond 30 days remains unverified, so the change should remain experimental rather than a broad rollout.
